lesson.title: A rogue DHCP server
lesson.goal: DeskPC got a wrong gateway from RogueRouter. Use DHCP snooping so the real server on the uplink answers instead.

step.text: On DeskPC run ipconfig /renew, then ipconfig. The address comes from RogueRouter and the default gateway is 10.50.0.254, which is wrong.
On Closet and ServerCloset turn on ip dhcp snooping.
Trust only the port that faces DhcpServer: on ServerCloset, interface FastEthernet0/2, ip dhcp snooping trust.
Renew again on DeskPC. The rogue offer is dropped and the gateway becomes 10.50.0.1.
